threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep saying 'the Tube' instead of 'the Overground'. Locals know you get everywhere here above ground.
Last night on the bus, a guy serenaded a couple with Morrissey lyrics while the driver just sighed. Brixton nightlife at its finest.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a group of kids turn an empty lot into a makeshift skate park with just a few crates and their creativity. That’s Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Kreuzberg, it's not unusual to see open-air yoga sessions in parks, often led by a man in a vintage tracksuit blasting techno. Only in Berlin.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they can name at least three taco trucks on the same block without missing a beat.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy practicing his trumpet on the bus while his dog looked on like it was a concert. Only in SF do you get free entertainment with your ride.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just about Gaudí. They miss the hidden plazas where locals sip vermut and gossip. That's where the real vibe is.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You'll see them staring at the metro map like it’s an ancient scroll, especially near Fontana station. Locals just glide by.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You know someone’s fresh when they stand bewildered at the Dalston Junction barrier, staring at the Oyster reader like it’s a magic portal.
Caught the N68 last night and saw a guy trying to barter a kebab for a bus ticket—only in Brixton! The driver was having none of it.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I realized I was home? Watching a kid ride a scooter past a street musician playing the sitar on Sonnenallee. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a street vendor selling currywurst alongside a gallery showcasing contemporary art. It's the blend of grit and creativity that defines this place.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know you're local when you stop to dodge the BART delays and just grab a burrito instead, like it's part of your commute.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 14 Mission using a baguette as a makeshift cane. He hobbled off at 16th, still swinging it like a trophy.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about Gaudí and parks, but real life here often plays out in the cramped bodega corners over cheap vermut and football debates.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their confusion over 'menú del día' pricing—it's always a shocker when lunch costs more than they expected.
